readerCopy.body: Chemistry can return before compatibility with the next version of life does. When Venus opposes the North Node, familiar connection and forward movement face each other directly, making an old relationship, collaboration, financial arrangement, or pleasure especially easy to revisit. The connection can still matter while the old terms fit less well than they once did. Present schedules, money, boundaries, and priorities provide a better test than familiarity alone.
